mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runtime_human_task ( id, workspace_id, subject_type, subject_id, thread_id, turn_id, item_id, kind, schema_ref, candidate_json, pending_pointers, assignee_json, status, expires_at, create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{threadId}, #{turnId}, #{itemId}, #{kind}, #{schemaRef}, #{candidateJson}, #{pendingPointers}, #{assigneeJson}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, now(), now(), COALESCE(#{createBy}, 'system'), COALESCE(#{updateBy}, 'system') )
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, item_id AS itemId, kind, schema_ref AS schemaRef, candidate_json AS candidateJson, pending_pointers AS pendingPointers, assignee_json AS assigneeJson, status, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_at AS decidedAt, answer_json AS answerJson, expires_at AS expiresAt, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM runtime_human_task WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, item_id AS itemId, kind, schema_ref AS schemaRef, candidate_json AS candidateJson, pending_pointers AS pendingPointers, assignee_json AS assigneeJson, status, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_at AS decidedAt, answer_json AS answerJson, expires_at AS expiresAt, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM runtime_human_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runtime_human_task WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'PENDING'

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, item_id AS itemId, kind, schema_ref AS schemaRef, candidate_json AS candidateJson, pending_pointers AS pendingPointers, assignee_json AS assigneeJson, status, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_at AS decidedAt, answer_json AS answerJson, expires_at AS expiresAt, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM runtime_human_task WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} ORDER BY create_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, item_id AS itemId, kind, schema_ref AS schemaRef, candidate_json AS candidateJson, pending_pointers AS pendingPointers, assignee_json AS assigneeJson, status, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_at AS decidedAt, answer_json AS answerJson, expires_at AS expiresAt, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM runtime_human_task WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY decided_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE runtime_human_task SET status = 'SUBMITTED', decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = now(), answer_json = #{answerJson}, update_at = now(), update_by = COALESCE(#{updateBy}, 'system') WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: UPDATE runtime_human_task SET status = 'EXPIRED', decided_by = COALESCE(#{decidedBy}, 'system'), decided_at = now(), update_at = now(), update_by = 'system' WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at < #{now} RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE runtime_human_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = now(), update_at = now(), update_by = 'system' WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'PENDING'
